summary: Strategy Inc filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement (Supplement No. 1 to its Series A Perpetual Strife Preferred Stock Annex) covering an at-the-market program of up to $1,659,967,526.88 of its 10.00% STRF preferred, listed on Nasdaq. The filing reflects a stockholder-approved amendment to the certificate of designations, effective January 1, 2027, shifting dividend payments from quarterly to each business day starting January 4, 2027. Last reported STRF price was $101.42 on October 30, 2026. This is a routine shelf/ATM takedown, not a special situation; watch distribution pace and preferred overhang.
